flags: BRIDGE: rec.gov notice 'Damsite West and Damsite East are separated by a river bridge with limited clearance and weight limits; larger vehicles and trailers may need to use either the west or east entrance to the park to avoid this bridge'. No figures are posted; each half has its own entrance, so EKKO can reach either side without the bridge. Caveat put in the note.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept. Below the dam on the Fall River tailwater (no lake value). Esri 2026-11-06: the channel is ~40-60 m wide by the bridge (a river), and the nearest sites (011-014 west, 016-018 east) sit ~30-50 m back behind a tree band and the access road. A filtered riverview from 014/016 is possible but nothing shows it.
SPLIT: not proposed. West (001-014) and East (016-033) halves have their own entrances but sit only ~150-200 m apart across the river and are one rec.gov facility.
